<page>
 Kennedy & Johnson LLP
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 832-555-5054
 Letter of Representation
20 Dec 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1088
Our client: Patrick Singh
Date of loss: 15 Dec 2024
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the collision described in the enclosed materials, and all further
communication regarding this matter should be directed to our office rather than to our client. Please do not contact the client
directly, either by telephone, in writing, or through any third party acting on the insurer's behalf.
We ask that you provide a written statement of the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to
the at-fault driver, together with confirmation of whether any excess or umbrella coverage applies. Please also identify the claims
representative assigned to this file.
Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on impact, and the medical treatment and recovery are ongoing. We therefore
request that the insurer preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including vehicle data and event recorder information,
photographs, repair and salvage records, witness statements, recodred calls, claim notes, and any telematics or dashcam footage.
Please suspend any routine destruction of such materials.
We look forward to your prompt written response.
Sincerely,
David Richardson
Kennedy & Johnson LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
